name: otome_mob_cheat_ship
about: Otome Game Mob story Short: Leon's stepmother orders him into an arranged marriage with a woman three times his age who has buried seven husbands; with no future otherwise, he remembers he knows this game - all he needs is money - and claims the paid DLC cheat ship before the heroine can. The drop runs Luxion waking, the treasure and the fleet; he ends declining the marriage, rich.
anime: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs
